map.64GB 卡、RAW 约 25MB/张：张数 = 64×1000÷25 ≈ 25: 64GB card, RAW ~25MB/shot: count = 64x1000/25 ~ 2560 shots; JPEG ~8MB -> 8000; at 10fps recording ~64x1000/(25x10x60) ~ 4.3 min.
map.单张 30MB、拍 1000 张需 30GB；14bit RAW 比压缩 JPE: 30MB/shot, 1000 shots need 30GB; 14-bit RAW is several times larger than compressed JPEG; estimate peak usage before burst to avoid filling.

map.视频为什么更吃容量？: Why does video eat more capacity?
map.视频是连续码流，4K 100Mbps 一分钟约 750MB，远快于单张；延时按帧: Video is a continuous stream; 4K 100Mbps ~750MB per minute, far faster than a single shot; timelapse by frame rate.
